title: Access acknowledgement
description: A peer's answer to an applied set: the epoch and digest it now holds, when it applied them (its clock), and the grants it could not apply and therefore denies.

state.description: replayed: the peer already held this epoch with this digest and changed nothing but the time it counts the set's age from.

digest.description: Digest of the set the peer holds, computed by the peer. bos treats a digest other than the one it sent as a failed push.

applied_at.description: When the peer applied the set or last confirmed it by a replay, by its clock. The age of the set, for the staleness limit, is counted from here.

unrepresentable.description: Grants of the set the peer cannot express. It denies each.

record_access.description: With a set that carries record_access entries: what the peer holds of them. Absent when the set carries none.

count.description: How many entries the peer holds.

digest.description: Digest of the entries the peer holds: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the array of entries, sorted by id, null dates left out (the same rule as the set's digest). bos treats a digest other than the one it computed as a failed push.

unrepresentable.description: Entries the peer cannot express, by entry id. It denies each.
